title: Battle of Monte Cassino
summary: Between January and May 1944, Allied forces made four attempts to break the German Gustav Line around the hill and monastery of Monte Cassino in Italy. The abbey was bombed on 15 February 1944, and Polish troops finally captured the position on 18 May 1944.

uncertainty.note: Start taken as the first British attack on 17 January 1944 (IWM); end as the Polish capture on 18 May 1944 (National WWII Museum).

as_recorded.value: On the 17th of January the British 5th and 56th divisions made their first attack
Polish troops finally captured Monte Cassino on May 18, 1944

where.modern_name: Montecassino Abbey, Cassino, Lazio, Italy (pin is the abbey, a proxy for the battle area)
where.historical_name: Monte Cassino and Cassino, Kingdom of Italy (German-held Gustav Line)

importance.justification: Major, costly Italian Campaign battle that included the controversial bombing of the historic abbey.

sources.title: Monte Cassino: The Bloodiest Battle Of The Italian Campaign
